column1: # The server this engine's committed answers come from. driver records the
# tapes through redis/internal/testcontainer: Redis 7.4.12, the last release of
# the 7.4 line and the newest 7.x, pinned by digest. The server is started
# cluster-enabled with every hash slot on its one node, because the driver's
# all-nodes query path needs a cluster; a standalone client reaches the same
# server for every other test. Redis has no grammar a server judges, so there
# is no compat.tsv pin and no second row.
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
